description: A sample Android InputMethodService implementation that demonstrates integrating a custom themed navigation bar with a software keyboard, including handling different navigation bar modes and UI adjustments.

classes.name: ThemedNavBarKeyboard
classes.description: Main class extending InputMethodService to implement a custom keyboard with themed navigation bar.

classes.name: BuildCompat
classes.description: Helper class to determine effective SDK version considering release or development build.

classes.name: InputViewMode
classes.description: Enum representing different modes of the input view related to navigation bar handling.

classes.name: KeyboardLayoutView
classes.description: Inner class extending LinearLayout that manages the keyboard UI and navigation bar modes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, disables navigation bar contrast enforcement on Android Q and above.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates and returns the custom keyboard layout view.

methods.name: onComputeInsets
methods.description: Adjusts insets for floating mode to avoid relayout issues.

methods.name: updateBottomPaddingIfNecessary
methods.description: Updates bottom padding of the layout if needed.

methods.name: createButton
methods.description: Helper to create a button with specified text and click callback.

methods.name: updateSystemUiFlag
methods.description: Updates system UI visibility flags related to navigation bar appearance.

methods.name: switchToFloatingMode
methods.description: Switches the input view to floating mode, adjusting window flags and UI.

methods.name: switchToSeparateNavBarMode
methods.description: Sets navigation bar color and UI flags for a mode where the system owns the nav bar.

methods.name: switchToExtendedNavBarMode
methods.description: Configures the UI for the IME to control the navigation bar appearance.
